run.question:
Alertmanager alert PendingPodsDetected (severity critical) is firing for service otel-demo/otel-demo since 2026-11-16T17:40:15Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The PendingPodsDetected alert for otel-demo is firing because exactly two pods are stuck unschedulable, and both are pinned to a non-existent node. Pods ad-dd7f45975-mw86p (created 17:39:18Z) and cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh (created 17:39:26Z) carry spec.nodeSelector {"kubernetes.io/hostname":"invalid-node"} and report PodScheduled=False/Unschedulable with the scheduler message "0/5 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint {node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: }, 4 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector". The selector comes from the pod templates of Deployments ad and cart (both generation 2, deployment.kubernetes.io/revision 2), which were rolled to a new ReplicaSet at 17:39:18Z and 17:39:26Z. No node in the cluster has kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node (the five nodes are i-01a47734339426210, i-037e40963128cbd9f, i-0424ef08cd107882f, i-08831c4b8af18ed15, i-097278082719f10ba). The two Deployments keep their previous, still-Running revision-1 pods (ad-554b849958-42mdm, cart-755465879b-bgb2p) and their Services' Endpoints contain only those old pods, so the user-facing ad and cart traffic did not stop; the damage is a stuck rollout plus two Pending pods and unavailableReplicas=1 on each Deployment. Two Deployments independently carry the same misconfiguration, so the alert has two parallel causes rather than one; the root_cause object names the first (ad), and Deployment cart is reported separately as the identical second cause. ad's low intermittent STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate is present both before and after 17:39 and is not tied to these pending pods.

claims.text: At 17:55:03Z namespace otel-demo had 23 pods, of which exactly two were Pending: ad-dd7f45975-mw86p and cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh; the other 21 were Running.

Both pending pods have condition PodScheduled=False, reason Unschedulable, message "0/5 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had untolerated taint {node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane: }, 4 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector. preemption: 0/5 nodes are available: 5 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling." with lastTransitionTime 17:39:18Z (ad pod) and 17:39:26Z (cart pod); neither pod has started containers.
Both pending pods have spec.nodeSelector {"kubernetes.io/hostname":"invalid-node"}: ad-dd7f45975-mw86p and cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh.

Deployments ad and cart both carry nodeSelector {"kubernetes.io/hostname":"invalid-node"} in spec.template.spec.nodeSelector; the same listing shows every other deployment in otel-demo (accounting, checkout, currency, email, flagd, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, product-catalog, quote, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart) with nodeSelector null.

The cluster has five nodes with kubernetes.io/hostname values i-01a47734339426210, i-037e40963128cbd9f, i-0424ef08cd107882f, i-08831c4b8af18ed15 and i-097278082719f10ba; none is named invalid-node, and none carries a hostname label of invalid-node. Only i-01a47734339426210 is tainted (node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane:NoSchedule); all five report Ready=True with MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure False.

The pending pods belong to new ReplicaSets: ad-dd7f45975 (deployment.kubernetes.io/revision 2, created 2026-11-16T17:39:18Z, replicas 1, readyReplicas null) owned by Deployment ad, and cart-5b597c6db5 (revision 2, created 2026-11-16T17:39:26Z, replicas 1, readyReplicas null) owned by Deployment cart; the revision-1 ReplicaSets ad-554b849958 (created 17:01:53Z) and cart-755465879b (created 17:01:52Z) still each have readyReplicas 1.

Kubernetes events for otel-demo show Deployment ad ScalingReplicaSet ad-dd7f45975 from 0 to 1 and ReplicaSet ad-dd7f45975 SuccessfulCreate of pod ad-dd7f45975-mw86p at 17:39:18Z, Deployment cart ScalingReplicaSet cart-5b597c6db5 from 0 to 1 and ReplicaSet cart-5b597c6db5 SuccessfulCreate of pod cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh at 17:39:26Z, plus repeated default-scheduler FailedScheduling warnings (count 3, first 17:39:18Z / 17:39:26Z, last 17:49:41Z) on those two pods with the node affinity/selector message.

Deployments ad and cart are both observedGeneration 2 with revision 2, condition Available=True reason MinimumReplicasAvailable and Progressing=True reason ReplicaSetUpdated ("ReplicaSet \"ad-dd7f45975\"/\"cart-5b597c6db5\" is progressing") last updated 17:39:18Z/17:39:26Z, and each reports unavailableReplicas 1.

Endpoints for Services ad and cart contain only the revision-1 pods: ad -> ad-554b849958-42mdm (100.96.3.180, node i-037e40963128cbd9f, port 8080) and cart -> cart-755465879b-bgb2p (100.96.3.205, node i-037e40963128cbd9f, port 8080); neither pending pod is an endpoint address.
Traffic kept flowing during the window: cart emitted roughly 4.1k-5.1k spans per 5 minutes (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) and ad roughly 380-630 spans per 5 minutes (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) from 17:25 to 17:55.

The ad service shows a low intermittent STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate of about 1.1-1.25 spans per 5 minutes both before and after the 17:39 rollout (e.g. 1.25 at 17:25:40, 1.11 at 17:26:40, then 1.11 values from 17:45:40 to 17:52:40, 0 at 17:55:00); no cart STATUS_CODE_ERROR series was returned.

Despite the pending pods, both Deployments still report readyReplicas 1 and availableReplicas 1, and their Available condition is True, so serving capacity for ad and cart was not lost; the failure is a stalled second-revision rollout.

The revision-1 pods serving the two affected Deployments are Running and Ready with restartCount 0 and no lastTerminationState: ad-554b849958-42mdm (container started 17:01:55Z) and cart-755465879b-bgb2p (container started 17:02:03Z).

The 17:39:18Z/17:39:26Z rollout that created revision-2 ReplicaSets on Deployments ad and cart introduced the nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node (likely via the Helm release otel-demo, per meta.helm.sh/release-name annotations), which is what made both new pods unschedulable; this is a timing/appearance correlation from current object state, not a recorded change event.

Cluster capacity, memory/disk/PID pressure or the control-plane taint is not the reason these pods are pending: the scheduler message attributes the failure to a node affinity/selector mismatch on 4 untainted nodes, and all five nodes report Ready=True with no MemoryPressure, DiskPressure or PIDPressure, while only the single control-plane node is tainted.

Image-pull, container-crash or OOM trouble is not the cause: both pending pods have no containers started and only a PodScheduled=False condition from the scheduler, and their owning ReplicaSets never produced a running container instance to fail.

gaps: The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so the actor, commit and exact values change that set nodeSelector kubernetes.io/hostname=invalid-node on Deployments ad and cart at ~17:39 cannot be verified; Secret content (Helm release data) also cannot be read.
The query for MutatingWebhookConfigurations failed with SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, so admission-webhook injection of the bad nodeSelector could be neither confirmed nor ruled out.
No ConfigMap in otel-demo contains the string invalid-node (4 ConfigMaps inspected), so the selector is not visible in a readable namespace ConfigMap; the source of the value remains unknown.

fetch_pod_logs returned no matching error/fail/exception/panic lines for ad-554b849958-42mdm (1254 lines read) or cart-755465879b-bgb2p (4310 lines read) in 17:39-17:55, and previous container instances were unavailable; logs cannot prove absence of errors, so application-log health is only partially checked.

kube_pod_status_phase returned no series for namespace otel-demo, so the pending count could not be corroborated as a metric time series or compared against the alert rule's own expression; list_prometheus_rules returned no PendingPodsDetected rule under that exact name.
Whether the two Pending pods existed before 17:39 cannot be checked from current object state; the earliest visible evidence is the 17:39:18Z/17:39:26Z creation times and events.
next_steps: Remove or correct the kubernetes.io/hostname: invalid-node nodeSelector in the pod templates of Deployments ad and cart (e.g. fix the otel-demo Helm values and re-apply) so the revision-2 ReplicaSets can schedule.
Confirm no node is intended to carry the hostname label invalid-node and, if a specific node was intended, use an existing node's kubernetes.io/hostname value.
Inspect the Helm release history for otel-demo around 2026-11-16T17:39Z to identify who introduced the invalid-node selector before rolling back or re-deploying.

After the selector is corrected, verify the pending pods ad-dd7f45975-mw86p and cart-5b597c6db5-pkzkh schedule, the revision-2 pods become Ready and Endpoints for ad and cart include them instead of only the revision-1 pods.
